360-1981-2415-2511.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1781-1978-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

6798-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7296-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-7296-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-3967-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

647-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4488-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

3259-6968--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6968--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

3025-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

64-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
64-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake
When Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
64-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1793-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library.
Repeat.

252-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

224-765-1359-1683.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-765-1359-1683.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Guildless Commons on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Guildless Commons from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

56-4054-5075-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-5075-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

719-4050-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-4050-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-4050-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Snail, adding one mana of any color.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
719-4050-5853.notes: If you have mana available, you may instead sacrifice the Snail to Wick's ability.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2665-2743.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

427-4067-4758-5766.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-4067-4758-5766.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat steps 2 and/or 3 as mana allows.

997-2867-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

539-2232-2374-2459.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
539-2232-2374-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, it and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

411-1322-3286.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Inga and Esika triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2744-2757-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You are able to put a +1/+1 counter onto a permanent you control.
2744-2757-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a permanent you control.
Animation Module triggers.
Pay {1} for the Animation Module trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers, placing a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping the Servo token, untapping your basic land.
Tap that basic land for {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

1561-4216.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing target opponent to draw half their library and lose half their life.
Activate Folio of Fancies's last ability by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their hand.
During their draw step, the opponent targeted in step 1 loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
